source_refs.note: 'Formulating correct hypotheses' under topic 7.2, as printed (PDF 95, printed 91).

blocks.text: Correct hypotheses must be clear and specific. They should be testable using data. Vague statements reduce accuracy. Hypotheses must match research questions. Variables should be defined clearly. Simple language improves understanding. Correct formulation saves time. It leads to reliable results. Proper hypotheses improve analysis quality.
